scripts.run:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "web,api,vision" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:vision"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "web,api,vision" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:vision"
scripts.dev:vision: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path services/vision/.venv/Scripts/python.exe) { & services/vision/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir services/vision } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir services/vision }"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:node && npm run test:vision
scripts.test:vision: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path services/vision/.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe) { & services/vision/.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe services/vision/tests -v } elseif (Get-Command pytest -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pytest services/vision/tests -v } else { Write-Warning 'Python pytest not installed in active environment; skipping vision pytest' }"
scripts.test:e2e: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Write-Host 'E2E Playwright test suite will be available in Prompt 09/10.'"
